guard_pose: upright composed stance facing right, right arm extended holding a slim katana pointed forward and slightly up

jab: quick precise straight thrust: drives the slim katana straight forward at full extension, then pulls it back into the stance
jab2: precise diagonal slash: swings the slim katana from high in front down to low in front in one fast cut, then back into the stance
ftilt: precise big forward cut: lifts the slim katana above his head and brings it straight down to low in front of him, then back into the stance
utilt: overhead arc: sweeps the slim katana from in front of him up over his head to behind him, then back into the stance
dtilt: crouching low cut: drops into a crouch and sweeps the slim katana low in front at shin height, then rises back into the stance
dashattack: gliding slash: glides forward in a flash step and cuts across with the slim katana in one horizontal stroke, then stops, composed, in the stance
fsmash: charged smash: raises the slim katana far behind his head, pink cherry-blossom blade petals swirling over the blade, then brings it down in a tremendous cut to the front, then recovers into the stance
usmash: rising smash: crouches, then swings the slim katana in a big arc from in front straight up over his head, pink cherry-blossom blade petals swirling trailing the blade, then back into the stance
dsmash: low spinning cut: slashes the slim katana low in front, then spins around and slashes low behind him, pink cherry-blossom blade petals swirling, then back into the stance
nair: double cut in mid-air: chops the slim katana down in front of him, then swings it back up, the blade circling close around his body, then back to the tucked pose
fair: crescent cut in mid-air: swings the slim katana in a big arc from above his head down to below him in front, then back to the tucked pose
bair: backward cut in mid-air: twists his torso and swings the slim katana behind him in a downward arc, then back to the tucked pose
uair: overhead arc in mid-air: swings the slim katana from behind him over his head to the front, then back to the tucked pose
dair: downward stab in mid-air: points the slim katana straight down beneath him and plunges it down, then pulls it back up to the tucked pose
ledgeattack: rises from a low crouch with a quick low horizontal cut of the slim katana forward at knee height, then back into the stance
getupattack: from lying on his back, swings the slim katana low across in front of him, then low behind him while springing to his feet, ending in the stance

nspecial: Scatter, Senbonzakura: holds the katana upright in front of his face, the blade dissolves into a cloud of countless tiny glowing pink cherry-blossom blades, he sweeps his free hand forward and the pink petal swarm streams slowly ahead of him, then the petals flow back and reform the blade as he returns to the stance
sspecial: Senka: vanishes in a flash step leaving a fading afterimage and a few pink petals, reappears and stabs the katana straight forward in one quick precise thrust, then returns to the stance
uspecial: upward flash step: bends the knees slightly, vanishes in a blur with a swirl of pink petals, then reappears in mid-air inside a small burst of pink blade petals, scarf and haori fluttering, the katana held at his side, legs hanging
dspecial: Bakudo 81, Danku: raises two fingers of his free hand and a flat translucent wall of pale light appears just in front of him, he holds it for a moment, then the wall shatters forward into a burst of pink blade petals, then he returns to the stance
ultimate: Bankai, Senbonzakura Kageyoshi: holds the katana point down and lets it drop, it vanishes beneath him, rows of tall glowing blades rise around him and scatter into a swirling storm of pink cherry-blossom blades circling close around his body, he guides it with a two-finger hand sign, then the storm bursts outward, then the petals gather back into his hand as the katana and he returns to the stance
w0_nspecial: Scatter, Senbonzakura at full strength: holds the katana upright, the blade bursts into a big cloud of glowing pink blade petals, he sweeps his hand forward and the dense swarm surges ahead of him, then the petals reform the blade as he returns to the stance
w0_ultimate: Gokei: the katana dissolves into countless glowing pink blade petals, he stretches his open hand forward and the petals swirl ahead of him and close into a sphere of pink blades, then he clenches his fist and the sphere bursts in a flash of pink, then the petals return and reform the katana as he returns to the stance
w1_dspecial: Senkei: forms a hand sign with two fingers raised, glowing pink blade petals spiral up around him and condense into a ring of tall shining swords close around his body, they whirl and slash around him, then burst outward, then he returns to the stance
w1_ultimate: Shukei, Hakuteiken: his pink blade petals condense into a single long sword of pure white light in his hand while white wings of light and a halo of light open behind his back, he flashes forward and strikes three quick cuts, then raises the white blade overhead and brings it down in one blinding slash, then the light fades and he returns to the stance
